scope: Proposed task designs refining the existing 147 broad questions; no new independent task count, validated endpoint mapping, fixture use or coverage credit.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Which cell populations are enriched in an independently collected tumor cohort relative to adjacent tissue and blood across donors?
designs.input_design: Observed single-cell counts, cell labels, three tissue compartments and linked donor/sample metadata with biological replication.
designs.provenance_requirements: Pin study accession, consent/use terms, count processing and annotation version; exclude the benchmark study and fixtures.
required_full_output_artifacts_with_key_: cells.tsv: cell_id, sample_id, donor_id, tissue, cell_type, qc_pass
fractions.tsv: donor_id, tissue, cell_type, numerator, denominator, fraction
enrichment.tsv: cell_type, contrast, effect, interval, p_value, q_value, eligibility
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Cell QC, tissue pairing, cell-type eligibility, denominator, enrichment test, multiple-testing universe and high-enrichment threshold.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design: Recompute every donor denominator and contrast from cells; compare full table to independent reference within frozen tolerances.
designs.negative_controls: Corrupt a donor denominator or report a contrast for an ineligible cell type; both output mutations must fail.
designs.unresolved_independent_data_and_runtime_: Need independent cohort containing all three compartments and enough paired donors; count-model runtime must be measured.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Are baseline immune-cell fractions associated with a later measured treatment response across independent patients?
designs.input_design: Observed pre-treatment single-cell samples and prospectively measured patient response, linked by patient identity and date.
designs.provenance_requirements: Pin cohort accession, treatment/response definitions, time ordering, rights and cell annotation provenance.
required_full_output_artifacts_with_key_: patients.tsv: patient_id, baseline_date, outcome_date, response, eligibility
fractions.tsv: patient_id, cell_type, eligible_cells, total_cells, fraction
associations.tsv: cell_type, n_patients, coefficient, interval, p_value, q_value
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Response ratio/scale, baseline window, fraction denominator, Pearson/Spearman or regression model, covariates and multiplicity.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design: Independent patient join, date ordering and correlation recomputation across all eligible cell types.
designs.negative_controls: Duplicate a patient outcome join or use a post-outcome sample as baseline; the submitted join and associations must fail.
designs.unresolved_independent_data_and_runtime_: Need independent longitudinal clinical outcome plus baseline cells; no inference of treatment causality.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: How do sequence composition and fixed predictor scores distinguish independently labeled protein assembly classes?
designs.input_design: Observed protein sequences with experimentally curated assembly-class labels and fixed scores from specified predictors.
designs.provenance_requirements: Pin FASTA, class evidence, predictor versions and negative-set construction; avoid source benchmark protein sets.
required_full_output_artifacts_with_key_: proteins.tsv: protein_id, sequence_hash, class, source, split
composition.tsv: protein_id, amino_acid, fraction
scores.tsv: protein_id, predictor, score, missing
performance.tsv: class, comparator, predictor, n_positive, n_negative, auroc, auprc, interval
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Protein deduplication, positive/negative class universe, amino-acid metric, score direction, ties, bootstrap unit and split.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design: Recompute sequence fractions, membership and ROC/PR from complete score rows; verify all declared predictors and classes.
designs.negative_controls: Reverse a nonconstant score vector without updating its metrics, and duplicate a protein across fit/evaluation groups; reject both when the frozen design separates those groups.
designs.unresolved_independent_data_and_runtime_: Independent experimental class labels and predictor score availability may be limiting; fixed scores keep task within 30 minutes.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Do frozen sequence predictors distinguish observed condensate participants better than membrane-organelle controls under one negative universe?
designs.input_design: Observed protein membership in multiple condensate and organelle sets plus a single fixed nonmember background and predictor scores.
designs.provenance_requirements: Pin membership studies, protein ID mapping, score versions and independent negative-set provenance.
required_full_output_artifacts_with_key_: membership.tsv: protein_id, dataset_id, class, evidence
scores.tsv: protein_id, predictor, score
comparisons.tsv: dataset_id, control_type, predictor, n_positive, n_fixed_negative, auroc, auprc, interval
consistency.tsv: predictor, condensate_minus_control, uncertainty
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Fixed negative universe, overlap policy, score orientation, metric, tie handling and aggregation across datasets.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design: Recompute each dataset ROC/PR against exactly the same negatives and compare complete dataset-by-predictor grid.
designs.negative_controls: Substitute a different negative universe or flip a membership label in the submitted artifacts; reject against the frozen inputs.
designs.unresolved_independent_data_and_runtime_: Need independently curated positive and organelle-control sets sharing identifiers and available frozen scores.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Which predicted ligand-receptor pathways connect independently observed activated cytotoxic and antigen-responsive T-cell populations?
designs.input_design: Observed inflamed-tissue single-cell expression with defensible gates for both populations and a frozen ligand-receptor database.
designs.provenance_requirements: Pin tissue study, cell-state gate evidence, count layer and database release; do not treat predictions as observed suppression.
required_full_output_artifacts_with_key_: cells.tsv: cell_id, donor_id, population, gate_evidence
ligand_receptor.tsv: ligand, receptor, database_id, direction
pair_scores.tsv: donor_id, ligand, receptor, source_population, target_population, score
pathways.tsv: pathway, n_pairs, aggregate_score, rank, uncertainty
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Cell gates, expression threshold, ligand/receptor direction, database release, donor aggregation, pathway mapping and exclusion of a known reference pathway.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design: Recompute expression support and pair/pathway scores with complete pair universe and donor strata.
designs.negative_controls: Swap the submitted source/target identities or insert a pair absent from the frozen database; reject provenance and directional mismatches.
designs.unresolved_independent_data_and_runtime_: Need independent cohort with both rare cell states and adequate donors; functional suppression cannot be graded from expression alone.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Is a prespecified cell-cycle gene set enriched among genes altered by both gain- and loss-of-function perturbations in one observed model?
designs.input_design: Two independent replicated perturbation count experiments with matched controls and frozen gene-set annotations.
designs.provenance_requirements: Pin deposited counts, sample metadata, intervention identities, tested-gene universe and gene-set release.
required_full_output_artifacts_with_key_: samples.tsv: sample_id, replicate, perturbation, control
contrasts.tsv: gene_id, perturbation, effect, p_value, q_value, testable
shared_genes.tsv: gene_id, gain_call, loss_call, shared_call
enrichment.tsv: gene_set, overlap, set_size, universe_size, p_value, q_value
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: DE model, call FDR/effect threshold, shared-gene direction requirement, enrichment test, universe and raw versus adjusted p threshold.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design: Recompute both full contrasts, intersection and hypergeometric/rank test from eligible genes.
designs.negative_controls: Insert a gene absent from one eligible perturbation contrast into the shared set, or change the enrichment universe size; reject both.
designs.unresolved_independent_data_and_runtime_: Need independently observed matched gain/loss experiments with replication; two full fits must meet 30 minutes.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Which measured tumor-associated microbial features predict worse survival in an independent oncology cohort under a fixed univariate Cox screen?
designs.input_design: Observed tumor microbiome abundance, patient survival and censoring, with one eligible tumor sample per patient.
designs.provenance_requirements: Pin microbiome processing, taxonomy release, patient cohort, survival follow-up and rights; no benchmark uploads.
required_full_output_artifacts_with_key_: patients.tsv: patient_id, sample_id, survival_time, event, eligibility
abundance.tsv: patient_id, taxon_id, transformed_abundance, detection
cox.tsv: taxon_id, n_patients, events, log_hazard, hazard_ratio, se, p_value, q_value, direction
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Abundance transform/zero handling, time origin, censoring, one-feature univariate model (covariate-adjusted models are a separately specified endpoint), HR>1 decision, p<0.05 rule and multiplicity reporting. Freeze tied-event handling (Efron/Breslow/exact), coefficient convergence and whether each p-value is Wald, score or likelihood-ratio; prescribe nonconvergent and non-estimable outputs.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design: Re-fit or independently compute Cox partial likelihood for all eligible taxa and check named prespecified target row.
designs.negative_controls: Flip an event indicator in the submitted patient table or misreport a hazard ratio relative to its log-hazard; reject both.
designs.unresolved_independent_data_and_runtime_: Need independent cohort with both microbial data and survival; avoid interpreting association as microbial causation.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Which paired circulating-protein changes differ between treatment regimens, and which track measured body changes in an independent longitudinal cohort?
designs.input_design: Observed baseline/follow-up proteomics, regimen labels and body measures on the same participants.
designs.provenance_requirements: Pin assay platform, protein IDs, visits, regimen assignment and body-measure provenance; no benchmark source cohort.
required_full_output_artifacts_with_key_: visits.tsv: participant_id, visit, date, regimen, body_measure, qc
protein_changes.tsv: participant_id, protein_id, baseline, followup, change
effects.tsv: protein_id, within_regimen_effect, regimen_interaction, se, p_value, q_value
correlations.tsv: protein_id, body_measure, n_participants, coefficient, p_value, q_value
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Visit windows, participant pairing, protein missingness, within-regimen effect, interaction model, body-change definition and multiplicity.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design: Recompute participant change, full protein effects and protein-body correlations from matched IDs.
designs.negative_controls: Swap follow-up patient IDs or duplicate a participant in the submitted change table; reject the invalid pairing.
designs.unresolved_independent_data_and_runtime_: Both endpoints require the same independently measured participants and assays; split if body measures are unmatched or fit exceeds 30 minutes.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Do treatment-associated protein effects overlap independent population sex associations after matching the measured protein universe?
designs.input_design: Observed paired treatment proteomics and separate published population proteomics effect table.
designs.provenance_requirements: Pin both study accessions, protein/isoform mappings, comparison direction, assay platforms and licenses.
required_full_output_artifacts_with_key_: effects.tsv: study_id, protein_id, effect, se, q_value, measured
matched_universe.tsv: protein_id, treatment_measured, population_measured, eligible
concordance.tsv: protein_id, treatment_call, sex_call, directional_agreement
summary.tsv: n_universe, n_overlap, expected_overlap, p_value
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Protein universe, FDR thresholds, sex/treatment effect orientation, overlap statistic and treatment sample pairing.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design: Independent identifier join and overlap/sign arithmetic over all measured proteins, not selected hits only.
designs.negative_controls: Reverse a nonzero submitted effect or remove a measured null protein from the matched universe; reject orientation or eligibility mismatch.
designs.unresolved_independent_data_and_runtime_: Need two independent cohorts with mappable common proteins and enough complete measures.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: How do longitudinal treatment-protein changes compare separately with menopausal transitions and hormone-treatment effects in independent cohorts?
designs.input_design: Observed paired treatment proteomics plus external longitudinal menopause and hormone-treatment effect summaries.
designs.provenance_requirements: Pin all cohort identities, assay versions, visit timing and effect direction/units.
required_full_output_artifacts_with_key_: effects.tsv: cohort_id, protein_id, contrast, effect, se, measured
matched_universe.tsv: protein_id, cohort_presence, eligible
concordance.tsv: comparator, protein_id, treatment_effect, external_effect, direction_match
summary.tsv: comparator, n, correlation, interval
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Keep menopause and exogenous hormone contrasts separate; freeze effect scale, protein mapping, missingness and concordance metric.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design: Recompute all matched effect pairs and comparator-specific direction/correlation summaries.
designs.negative_controls: Swap comparator IDs in the submitted paired-effect table or pool the two comparator summaries; reject against their distinct source contrasts.
designs.unresolved_independent_data_and_runtime_: Three assay-compatible observed cohorts may be difficult to source; precomputed effects must retain raw-study provenance.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Which prespecified immune signatures have similar score profiles across independently observed sepsis patients?
designs.input_design: Observed patient-by-signature score matrix with sample identity and a separately frozen signature definition.
designs.provenance_requirements: Pin cohort accession, signature calculation version and patient eligibility.
required_full_output_artifacts_with_key_: scores.tsv: patient_id, signature_id, score, missing
signature_correlations.tsv: signature_a, signature_b, n_patients, correlation
signature_tree.nwk: signature_id leaves with finite branch lengths
signature_clusters.tsv: signature_id, cluster_id, cutoff
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Correlate signatures across patients, not patients across signatures; freeze missingness, correlation, distance, linkage and cut height.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design: Recompute every signature pair, distance, deterministic linkage and complete signature membership.
designs.negative_controls: Submit patient IDs as tree leaves or omit an eligible signature pair; reject axis or completeness errors.
designs.unresolved_independent_data_and_runtime_: Need enough signatures/patients and stable scores; source cohort must be independent.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: What fraction of eligible intensive-care patients belongs to each independently assigned immune-state subgroup?
designs.input_design: Observed patient eligibility and immune subgroup labels from a frozen classifier or measured criteria.
designs.provenance_requirements: Pin cohort, subgroup algorithm, missing-label policy and identity deduplication.
required_full_output_artifacts_with_key_: patients.tsv: patient_id, eligible, subgroup, assignment_source
subgroup_counts.tsv: subgroup, numerator, denominator, fraction, missing_count
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Eligible denominator, one patient per row, exclusive versus overlapping subgroup semantics and missing assignment handling.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design: Recount unique patient IDs and verify fraction sum under exclusive labels.
designs.negative_controls: Count visits instead of unique patients or handle an unassigned patient contrary to the fixed policy; reject the resulting count table.
designs.unresolved_independent_data_and_runtime_: Independent subgroup labels must be available; this is separate from clustering signatures by correlation.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Are genes within two independently defined immune programs coexpressed across eligible patient samples?
designs.input_design: Observed expression matrix, patient metadata and two frozen gene-set memberships.
designs.provenance_requirements: Pin assay, normalization, gene IDs, program sources and eligible patient cohort.
required_full_output_artifacts_with_key_: eligible_genes.tsv: gene_set, gene_id, measured, eligible
pairs.tsv: gene_set, gene_a, gene_b, n_patients, correlation, p_value
set_summary.tsv: gene_set, n_genes, n_unique_pairs, aggregate, interval
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Patient universe, normalization, duplicate gene mapping, all unordered non-self pairs, correlation type and set aggregate.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design: Recompute complete pair matrix and exact n(n-1)/2 unique-pair count per set.
designs.negative_controls: Add self-pairs or duplicate an unordered pair in the submitted correlation table; reject even if aggregate values happen to agree.
designs.unresolved_independent_data_and_runtime_: Need both programs measured with enough independent patients.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Which spinal-cord expression differences between cases and controls persist after adjustment, and which genes track measured disease duration within cases?
designs.input_design: Independent human spinal-cord RNA counts with diagnosis, tissue segment, patient identity and disease-duration measurements.
designs.provenance_requirements: Pin accession, sample exclusions, anatomical region, count version and duration units; do not use benchmark cohort.
required_full_output_artifacts_with_key_: samples.tsv: sample_id, patient_id, diagnosis, segment, duration, qc
design.tsv: sample_id, model_coefficient
differential.tsv: gene_id, base_mean, effect, se, p_value, q_value
duration.tsv: gene_id, n_cases, coefficient, se, p_value, q_value
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Disease contrast covariates, count filtering, duration definition, within-case association model, FDR universes and top-gene ranking.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design: Recompute model design and full per-gene test tables with independent fitted reference.
designs.negative_controls: Reverse a nonzero disease effect or join duration to the wrong patient in the submitted artifacts; reject each against its own estimand.
designs.unresolved_independent_data_and_runtime_: Same independent cohort must contain adequate controls and measured durations; duration correlation is not validated progression prediction.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Which coexpression modules in independent spinal-cord samples associate with disease status under a reproducible weighted-network workflow?
designs.input_design: Observed normalized expression from adequate independent patient samples with case/control metadata.
designs.provenance_requirements: Pin cohort, platform, filtering, genes, samples and WGCNA package/version.
required_full_output_artifacts_with_key_: qc.tsv: sample_id, outlier, inclusion
power.tsv: power, fit_index, mean_connectivity, selected
modules.tsv: gene_id, module_id, membership
eigengenes.tsv: sample_id, module_id, value
trait_tests.tsv: module_id, trait, coefficient, p_value, q_value
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Outlier rule, gene count, soft-threshold power, adjacency/TOM, module cut/merge and trait test.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design: Check native WGCNA outputs plus independent adjacency/eigengene/association invariants and complete membership.
designs.negative_controls: Change a submitted module membership or trait coefficient while leaving source inputs fixed; reject. Input row permutations must preserve label-invariant results within frozen numerical tolerances.
designs.unresolved_independent_data_and_runtime_: WGCNA can exceed 30 minutes or memory on full transcriptomes; bounded observed subset and runtime measurement required.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Which independently measured molecular features show the same disease-effect direction in tissue RNA, tissue protein and biofluid protein?
designs.input_design: Three observed assay layers from a coherent independent disease study, with sample and feature mapping.
designs.provenance_requirements: Pin each assay accession, sample relationship, protein/isoform mapping, biofluid identity and rights.
required_full_output_artifacts_with_key_: layer_effects.tsv: assay, feature_id, effect, se, q_value, measured
crosswalk.tsv: gene_id, protein_id, mapping_status
concordance.tsv: gene_id, rna_effect, tissue_protein_effect, biofluid_protein_effect, all_measured, all_direction_match
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Within-layer disease designs, measured-feature intersection, ID ambiguity, sign convention and all-three significance rule.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design: Recompute joins and sign criteria across complete eligible gene/protein universe.
designs.negative_controls: Claim three-layer support for a feature absent from one assay or reverse a nonzero assay effect; reject incomplete or inconsistent evidence.
designs.unresolved_independent_data_and_runtime_: Independent study must include matching tissue RNA/protein and biofluid protein; unmatched layers cannot support patient-level concordance.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Can unsupervised expression profiles from an independent liver cohort define stable patient groups associated with separately measured pathology?
designs.input_design: Observed liver expression and patient pathology stages, with clinical labels withheld during clustering.
designs.provenance_requirements: Pin cohort, pathology scoring version, normalization, sample identity and data rights.
required_full_output_artifacts_with_key_: samples.tsv: patient_id, sample_id, eligible, pathology
embedding.tsv: patient_id, pc1, pc2, cluster_id
clusters.tsv: patient_id, cluster_id, assignment_confidence
clinical_tests.tsv: clinical_feature, cluster, n, statistic, p_value, q_value
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Choose PCA/hierarchical workflow, distance/linkage, cluster count without outcomes, pathology encoding and multiplicity.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design: Recompute normalized matrix, eigen/subspace or dendrogram invariant, full memberships and clinical contingency/tests.
designs.negative_controls: Assign a nonexistent or duplicate patient to a cluster, or misreport a clinical contingency cell; reject. Outcome-label changes must leave outcome-independent clustering unchanged.
designs.unresolved_independent_data_and_runtime_: Independent cohort needs sufficiently varied pathology and sample count; this is exploratory association, not a diagnosis.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Do circulating immune-population frequencies differ by disease status, and are those disease effects modified by ancestry in an independent cohort?
designs.input_design: Observed blood single-cell profiles with patient diagnosis, ancestry and enough samples in every interaction cell.
designs.provenance_requirements: Pin cohort, ancestry ascertainment, cell annotation, counts and data rights.
required_full_output_artifacts_with_key_: patients.tsv: patient_id, diagnosis, ancestry, qc
fractions.tsv: patient_id, cell_type, numerator, denominator, fraction
effects.tsv: cell_type, disease_effect, ancestry_effect, interaction_effect, se, p_value, q_value
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Population gates, patient denominator, ancestry categories, compositional model, disease-by-ancestry interaction and FDR.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design: Recompute frequencies and direct interaction coefficients, not separate-significance comparisons.
designs.negative_controls: Pool cells across patients or substitute a difference of separate significance calls for the required interaction coefficient; reject invalid replicate and contrast artifacts.
designs.unresolved_independent_data_and_runtime_: Need all diagnosis/ancestry strata with biological replication; historical ancestry labels may not be comparable.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Which classical-monocyte genes differ between independently observed autoimmune cases and controls at donor level?
designs.input_design: Observed single-cell counts with classical-monocyte labels and linked donor diagnosis.
designs.provenance_requirements: Pin cohort, count/annotation versions and donor identity; no benchmark cell files.
required_full_output_artifacts_with_key_: cells.tsv: cell_id, donor_id, monocyte_gate, qc
pseudobulk.tsv: gene_id, donor_id, count
design.tsv: donor_id, diagnosis, covariates
results.tsv: gene_id, base_mean, effect, se, p_value, q_value
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Monocyte gate, minimum cells per donor, count filter, donor-level design and FDR universe.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design: Reaggregate counts from eligible cells and independently fit complete donor-level differential model.
designs.negative_controls: Report cell-level rows as independent donor replicates or misaggregate one donor count; reject the submitted design and pseudobulk artifacts.
designs.unresolved_independent_data_and_runtime_: Need enough donors and monocyte cells; raw-count fit must complete within task limit.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: How do patient-level alteration frequencies differ across independently observed receptor-defined breast-cancer subgroups?
designs.input_design: Observed somatic mutation calls and clinical receptor subtype metadata, one patient identity across samples.
designs.provenance_requirements: Pin MAF/VCF processing, reference, transcript and clinical subtype definitions.
required_full_output_artifacts_with_key_: patients.tsv: patient_id, receptor_subtype, eligible
alterations.tsv: patient_id, gene_id, variant_id, consequence, qualifying
landscape.tsv: subtype, gene_id, altered_patients, eligible_patients, fraction, comparison_p
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Four receptor groups, qualifying alteration mask, patient/sample collapse, missing subtype policy and tested-gene universe.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design: Recompute patient-gene binary events, subtype denominators and all frequency comparisons.
designs.negative_controls: Count two mutations in one patient-gene as two altered patients or change a receptor-group denominator; reject the inflated frequencies.
designs.unresolved_independent_data_and_runtime_: Independent cohort needs all subtype groups and consistent mutation calling; no actionability inference from frequency alone.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Among independently observed post-treatment receptor-positive tumors, how prevalent are pathway alterations and how do they co-occur with a prespecified resistance gene?
designs.input_design: Somatic calls linked to treatment timing and receptor status in one eligible patient universe.
designs.provenance_requirements: Pin therapy dates, receptor definitions, pathway release, mutation calls and evidence for post-treatment samples.
required_full_output_artifacts_with_key_: patients.tsv: patient_id, receptor_status, therapy_date, biopsy_date, eligible
events.tsv: patient_id, pathway_altered, resistance_gene_altered, qualifying_variants
prevalence.tsv: event, numerator, denominator, fraction
contingency.tsv: both, pathway_only, gene_only, neither, odds_ratio, p_value
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Post-therapy eligibility, pathway genes, alteration mask, patient union, 2x2 test/sidedness and multiple samples.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design: Recompute union prevalence and complete contingency from patient-level event flags.
designs.negative_controls: Double-count a patient with two pathway genes or omit double-negative patients from the contingency table; reject both.
designs.unresolved_independent_data_and_runtime_: Independent cohort must have treatment timing; cooccurrence is not mechanistic endocrine resistance.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Which genes show reproducible downregulation after an independently observed perturbation in a fusion-positive leukemia model?
designs.input_design: Replicated treatment and vehicle RNA counts in a relevant observed leukemia model.
designs.provenance_requirements: Pin cell model identity, perturbation assay, dose/time, count processing and rights.
required_full_output_artifacts_with_key_: samples.tsv: sample_id, biological_replicate, condition, qc
design.tsv: sample_id, coefficients
results.tsv: gene_id, base_mean, log2_effect, se, p_value, q_value, rank
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Treatment/vehicle design, replicate pairing, count filter, FDR, downregulation sign and ranking.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design: Independently fit full gene-level contrast and verify complete ranked set.
designs.negative_controls: Reverse a nonzero treatment effect or omit an eligible nonsignificant gene from the full results; reject sign or completeness errors.
designs.unresolved_independent_data_and_runtime_: Independent perturbation study with replication required; do not infer therapeutic targets from DE alone.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: How does experimentally measured transcription-factor occupancy change after perturbation in an independent leukemia system?
designs.input_design: Observed ChIP/CUT&Tag treatment/control reads with input/control libraries and biological replicates.
designs.provenance_requirements: Pin factor antibody, genome, peak universe, sequencing and control provenance.
required_full_output_artifacts_with_key_: libraries.tsv: library_id, replicate, condition, assay, qc
regions.bed: chromosome, start, end, region_id
counts.tsv: region_id, library_id, fragments
occupancy.tsv: region_id, effect, se, p_value, q_value, nearest_gene
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Genome assembly, alignment QC, consensus peaks, background/control correction, normalization and differential model.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design: Verify interval/count joins and native differential occupancy results over complete region universe.
designs.negative_controls: Change submitted peak coordinates or omit a required assay control from the submitted design; reject against the fixed input/assay contract.
designs.unresolved_independent_data_and_runtime_: Independent factor-binding data with matched perturbation needed; occupancy alone does not establish regulation.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Which independently measured enhancer-associated acetylation regions decrease after a controlled perturbation?
designs.input_design: Observed histone-mark ChIP/CUT&Tag signal and input/control libraries with enhancer annotation and replicates.
designs.provenance_requirements: Pin histone mark, enhancer atlas, assembly, peak caller and library conditions.
required_full_output_artifacts_with_key_: enhancers.bed: chromosome, start, end, enhancer_id
counts.tsv: enhancer_id, library_id, fragments
results.tsv: enhancer_id, effect, se, p_value, q_value, decreased_call
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Enhancer definition, overlap, signal/control correction, normalization, differential design and decreasing rank.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design: Recompute region counts and full contrast including non-significant enhancers.
designs.negative_controls: Swap signal/control identities or change enhancer boundaries in submitted artifacts; reject provenance and count inconsistencies.
designs.unresolved_independent_data_and_runtime_: Observed matched enhancer signal with biological replicates required; chromatin signal is not enhancer function proof.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Does an independently measured treatment alter the distribution of chromatin accessibility across a prespecified common region universe?
designs.input_design: Observed ATAC fragment libraries from replicated treatment and control samples with an external normalization anchor if absolute shift is claimed.
designs.provenance_requirements: Pin sample conditions, fragments, common-region construction, spike-in/reference evidence and assembly.
required_full_output_artifacts_with_key_: libraries.tsv: library_id, replicate, condition, depth, qc
regions.bed: chromosome, start, end, region_id

design_principles: Each row is a proposed original observed-data task design, not a runnable recipe or a claim that the benchmark endpoint is covered.
Negative controls are verifier mutations of a legitimate observed input or artifact, not generated biological observations.
Inputs, numerical decisions, complete output schemas, oracle independence and 30-minute runtime remain to be validated before authoring.

Negative controls mutate submitted artifacts against fixed, real observations. They are proposed checks; no mutation results are claimed. Input perturbations require an explicit expected invariant or a recomputed oracle, never an assumption that random permutation changes significance.

Prefer source-native biological formats for inputs (for example H5AD, count matrices, BAM/CRAM, BED, MAF/VCF, FASTA and assay-specific tables). Output tables are analysis artifacts; they do not justify replacing structured biological inputs with toy CSV files.

Package reference runs and independent invariants are both required. Sharing the oracle implementation with the solver or verifier is not evidence of independent correctness. Freeze every output schema and numerical tolerance before execution.

Public benchmark study accessions are exclusion checks for independent data selection. Document accession, release, license, checksum, biological dimensions, donor/replicate structure and any bounded subset; never use benchmark fixture bytes or answers.

Endpoint review is based on question text only. Assay details, supplementary methods, independent data availability and runtime remain unresolved; no design is implementation-ready solely because its question was reviewed.
grouping_rationale: Combined da-13-1/13-3 because both can use one paired longitudinal protein and body-measure cohort, subject to matching actual samples.
Combined da-17-1/17-5 because both are patient-level immune-frequency tests on one diagnosis-by-ancestry design; split monocyte gene-level pseudobulk da-17-3.
Combined da-18-5/18-7 because pathway prevalence and ESR1-pathway cooccurrence share one therapy-timed patient-event matrix; receptor-subtype landscape da-18-1 needs a broader cohort.
Combined da-3-4/3-5 because burden-response and per-variant response enrichment can share a single assay-comparable mutation/response cohort.
Split the two protein-predictor questions because class-specific composition and MLO-versus-organelle screening use different positive/control universes.

Split ALS WGCNA from expression/duration models because the network method and runtime are distinct; split each AML chromatin/RNA assay and each primary-cell baseline/compound endpoint because they require different inputs and scientific decisions.

Split cross-study protein concordance by external comparator, signature clustering from subgroup prevalence, clinical survival from NMF, phosphosite from total-protein target evidence, and single-organ from multi-organ training responses.
Keep da-24-3 as alternative GWAS methods, not an exact endpoint, because the public question does not name a statistic or trait pair.
